description: Dashboard del PTGM - Infrastrutture di trasporto – Ferrovie is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Piemonte. Lunghezza delle ferrovie nel territorio della Città metropolitana di Torino, per tipologia di linea e per comune. (fonte Città metropolitana di Torino, Regione Piemonte). Coverage: Regione Piemonte. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Piemonte. Its tags are alta-velocita, amministrazione, citta, citta-metropolitana, comune. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
